messages:
maria: thinking about the demux migration for cross-tenant prefetch ownership. goal = move ownership of prefix shards without breaking read-after-write or causing fetch storms. sketching a plan, want quick feedback.
jordan: sounds good. main risk is races between old handers and new. do we have a notion of transfer epoch?
lee: +1 epoch. also we should have a shadow-read fallback if epochs mismatch. simple and safe.
maria: initial idea: attach an epoch + handoff-id to prefetched entries. when serving, if req.epoch < entry.epoch -> fallback to shadow read and surface metric.
nate: agree on metrics. we need per-tenant fallback_count, handoff_conflicts, and stale-write-rejects. gate rollout by those.
samira: rollout plan suggestion: 1) feature-flag opt-in for a small cohort 2) enable epoch tagging + log-only for shadow fallbacks 3) canary at 5 tenants 4) phased ramp to 25% tenants 5) full flip when metrics stable; rollback if fallback >0.5% over 30m.
jordan: eviction nuance: on handoff we should soft-demote entries instead of hard delete. otherwise two nodes will both fetch and spike DB. soft-demote => mark not-promotable + TTL shrink.
lee: soft-demote idea is good. also add a grace interval: accept reads but delay writes until ownership confirms. that reduces RAWrite surprises.
maria: here's a tiny pseudo patch for the read path: ```
if req.epoch < cache.entry.epoch:
  metric.increment("fallback_shadow_read")
  return shadow_read(req)
else:
  return serve_from_cache(req)
```
nate: how long do we keep the handoff-id? also need to reject stale writes: if write.handoff_id != entry.handoff_id => reject with retry-after.
samira: staled-write reject makes sense. put a client-visible retry header so higher layers can backoff.
jordan: multi-key transactions worry me. if ownership moves mid-tx we might see partial commit semantics. 2PC would be correct but heavy.
lee: alternative: block transfers while any long-lived cursor touches the affected prefix. instrument cursor durations and set a threshold (e.g., 10s) to delay.
maria: plan: instrument cursors + long-op gauge. migration controller will refuse to move a shard if long_cursor_pct > 0.5%.
nate: for eviction coupling: when we demote, push the entry into a soft-evict pool and expose "soft_demote_count" metric. if soft_demote_count grows too large we can throttle demotes.
samira: monitoring: fallback_rate, soft_demote_count, stale_writes_rejected, handoff_blocked_reasons. set alert if fallback_rate > 0.2% for 15m during canary.
jordan: naming nit: header X-Prefetch-Epoch is long. suggest PF-Epoch or Prefetch-Epoch.
maria: PF-Epoch works. also header PF-Handoff-Id for write checks.
infra-bot: feature-flag created: prefetched_demux_v2 (owners: @maria, @samira), initial set: 10 tenants.
lee: test matrix: unit tests for epoch compare, integration test for soft-demote -> shadow read behavior, chaos test for concurrent handoff + eviction. I'll take correctness tests.
nate: I'll add stress tests for eviction + demux flip with hotspot tenants. measure DB QPS during handoff.
samira: I'll run the canary and watch metrics. if fallback exceeds 0.5% for 30m we roll back flag per plan.
maria: i'll draft an RFC update with the conv and attach the pseudo-code + metric list + rollout steps. will link PR when ready.
jordan: thanks — happy to review. :thumbsup:
maria: anyone else want to co-author the RFC?
lee: i will help on correctness section.
nate: i'll add the stress test plans.
samira: i'll own canary ops.
maria: cool, closing thread — will post RFC link soon.
